ui.analysis.benchmark_pending: {{name}} prices are not available yet; the comparison appears when they arrive.
ui.analysis.chart_legend: Each candle is one year: the open is 0%, the body ends at the change, the wicks show the high and low relative to the open. * = in progress.
ui.analysis.chart_legend_benchmark: Each candle is one year: the open is 0%, the body ends at the change, the wicks show the high and low relative to the open; the gray dash is the benchmark over the same dates. * = in progress.
ui.analysis.col.excess_tip: Stock change minus the benchmark's change over the same dates
ui.analysis.col.n_tip: Complete years with prices / years asked for
ui.analysis.col.up_tip: Years with a positive change, out of the complete past years; then the 95% Wilson interval of that share
ui.analysis.conclusion.coin_flip_one: {{count}} sample cannot distinguish this from a coin flip
ui.analysis.conclusion.coin_flip_other: {{count}} samples cannot distinguish this from a coin flip
ui.analysis.conclusion.empty: {{period}}: no complete past year with prices for {{ticker}} yet.
ui.analysis.empty.interval_body: Enter up to 20 tickers and a start and end date on the left (e.g. Sep 20 → Oct 15; an end before the start continues into the next year). Each year runs from the open of the first session on or after the start to the close of the last session on or before the end.
ui.analysis.empty.interval_title: How did the same dates go each year?
ui.analysis.empty.monthly_body: Enter up to 20 tickers on the left. Each month is measured from its first session's open to its last session's close, for this year and the past years you choose; prices are fetched once and kept for 24 hours.
ui.analysis.expired_refetching: Prices older than 24 hours were deleted; fetching again…
ui.analysis.method.benchmark: The benchmark is measured over the same first and last session dates, also open → close. Excess = stock change − benchmark change (a simple difference, not risk-adjusted); beat = excess above 0.
ui.analysis.method.cache: Each ticker's prices are fetched once for the whole range and kept for 24 hours; then they and these results are deleted and fetched again when the page is opened. Export the CSV to keep a result.
ui.analysis.method.candle_interval: Each year's interval is one candle: it starts at the open of the first session on or after the start date and ends at the close of the last session on or before the end date (an end before the start falls in the next year; Feb 29 is Feb 28 in other years).
ui.analysis.method.candle_monthly: Each year's month is one candle: open = the open of the month's first session; close = the close of its last session; high and low = the highest high and lowest low in between.
ui.analysis.method.change: Change = close / open − 1, a price return.
ui.analysis.method.gap: The gap from the previous close to the first open is not included, so monthly changes cannot be chained into a yearly change.
ui.analysis.method.interval: The 95% interval of the up-ratio is the Wilson score interval, assuming independent years. It describes the past, not a probability for this year; when it contains 50%, the up-ratio cannot be told apart from a coin flip.
ui.analysis.method.missing: A year without its first open or last close is left out (never counted as 0); sessions missing in between are listed in the details and do not change the open → close result.
ui.analysis.method.prices: Daily prices from Yahoo, adjusted for splits only; open, high, low and close carry the same split factor; cash dividends are not included.
ui.analysis.method.quartiles: Quartiles use linear interpolation between the sorted years.
ui.analysis.method.title: How this is calculated
ui.analysis.method.up: Up = change above 0; a change of exactly 0 is not up. Median and mean are over the same N years.
ui.analysis.method.years: Statistics use the complete past years only; the current year is shown separately and marked in progress until its period ends.
ui.analysis.not_found: This research no longer exists. Run it again from the conditions on the left.
ui.analysis.progress.title: Fetching and computing
ui.analysis.status.incomplete: First open or last close missing
ui.analysis.box.legend: Box: middle 50%, line: median; whiskers: observations within 1.5×IQR. Each point is one observation; outlined points are outliers. Complete past years only for monthly and interval studies. Diamonds show the current year separately, excluded from box statistics.
ui.analysis.cache_result: Each input is kept for 24 hours from fetching. This result deletes {{expires}}, when the earliest input expires.
ui.analysis.basis.label: Distribution basis
ui.analysis.sector.hint: Each stock uses its own sector. Industry groups without a primary ETF fall back to their sector.
ui.analysis.sector.fallback: No primary industry group ETF; using the sector ETF
ui.analysis.sector.legacy: This result does not include sector comparison; recalculating with the current references.
ui.analysis.conclusion.beat_sector: beat its sector in {{beat}}/{{n}}, with median sector excess {{excess}}
ui.analysis.sector.legacy_short: No sector comparison in this result
